name: OIDC_ISSUER
label: Issuer URL
setupSteps: Enter the base URL of your identity provider's OIDC issuer — the value it publishes as `issuer`, without a trailing slash.
The connector reads {ISSUER}/.well-known/openid-configuration to discover the authorization, token and JWKS endpoints, so no other URLs need configuring.
Keycloak: https://your-host/realms/{realm}. Okta: https://your-org.okta.com. Authentik: https://your-host/application/o/{slug}. ADFS: https://your-host/adfs.
Must be reachable over HTTPS from this deployment, and every endpoint it advertises must share this origin.

name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
label: Client ID
setupSteps: In your identity provider, register a confidential client (one that can hold a secret) for this deployment.
Set its redirect URI to the value below, exactly.
Grant it the `openid` and `email` scopes; the connector requests both regardless and cannot sign anyone in without them.
Ensure the client's ID token includes a verified `email` claim. Sign-in is refused when `email_verified` is not true, because Workshop accounts are keyed by email.

name: OIDC_SCOPES
label: Additional scopes (leave blank unless your provider needs one)
setupSteps: Space-separated scopes to request in addition to `openid` and `email`, which are always included.
Leave blank unless your provider needs an extra scope to release the email claim.

name: OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM
label: Groups claim (optional — leave blank unless this deployment uses org separation)
setupSteps: Optional. Leave blank unless this deployment separates users into orgs by identity provider group.

Enter the name of the ID token claim that carries group membership. There is no standard name, so check your provider — it is often not included by default and needs a mapper or claims configuration to appear.
A missing or ambiguous claim always resolves to no org, never a default org, so a misconfiguration here fails closed.

Microsoft Entra: above 200 groups (JWT) or 150 (SAML), Entra omits this claim entirely unless the app registration is configured to emit only application-assigned groups. See docs/configuration.md for details.

name: OIDC_ORG_PREFIX
label: Org group prefix (optional — leave blank unless this deployment uses org separation)
setupSteps: Optional. Only meaningful when the groups claim above is also set.

A prefix marking which groups are orgs, e.g. `fieldos-` so the group `fieldos-legal` yields org `legal`. Users are typically members of many groups unrelated to this deployment, so a prefix is usually needed to pick the right one out.
Leave blank to treat every group name in the claim as a candidate org (only safe if the provider is configured to emit exactly the relevant groups).
